run_dir.description: Existing verified run beneath repository artifacts/runs; original symlink/traversal components reject.

selection.description: Explicit run-relative selection JSON with source-bound stable marker IDs; no latest/subset discovery.

profile.description: Explicit run-relative closed editor_marker_export_profile JSON binding the planner profile by SHA-256, the DF/NDF timecode mode/origin and, for fcpxml, an explicit percent-encoded file:/// media URL. No executable/editor API configuration.

format.description: fcpxml requires a final_cut_pro planner profile; resolve_ops requires davinci_resolve.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard owned-worker/process-group deadline.

limitations: Writes only to a fresh exclusive <run_dir>/editor-export-<format>-<export_profile_sha256[:12]> directory chosen by the dispatcher; an existing path rejects and nothing is overwritten. Abstention creates no file or directory. Summary stdout <=64KiB, stderr <=16KiB, Info.fcpxml <=4MiB, sidecar <=16MiB; planner bounds are inherited (<=1000 actions or selection_required with no truncation).

Cadence is measured only from the complete PTS table; average/nominal frame rate, header frame counts and file names never satisfy a check. The October 5, 2026 take is VFR and abstains with calibration_required / cadence variable.

Valid XML is not an import: application_import is not_performed, final_cut_version/resolve_version are null, api_contract is unverified, executable is false and host_frame_id is null. The MCP hook exposes no DTD input, so dtd_validation is always not_performed here.
Display timecode labels (NDF everywhere; DF only at 30000/1001, 60000/1001, 120000/1001) are sidecar identifiers with an unverified host basis; they never change media time or samples.

Markers remain needs_review hypotheses. No note-correctness, missed/extra-note or mistake verdict, no listening, mastering or AU/Logic acceptance; listening_acceptance and musical_verdict stay not_established.

dependencies.note: Requires current generic markers, manifest, flags/DAG context, an explicit selection, a hash-bound planner profile with a complete PTS artifact and the closed export profile. Prior tools are not invoked automatically; the exporter calls the planner worker unchanged.

agent_workflow.identify: Run editor_marker_plan first; inspect plan_status, dispositions, collisions and whether a complete PTS artifact is bound before requesting export.
agent_workflow.research: Read docs/spec/EDITOR_MARKER_EXPORT.md and docs/research/EDITOR_MARKERS.md; a uniform fixture grid is a repository policy, not a host editor rule.
agent_workflow.iterate: Change one explicit planner/export profile file at a time with updated digests; compare reasons, cadence evidence, exported/excluded rows and quantization errors. Treat calibration_required as a valid result and obtain host calibration evidence instead of forcing a grid.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A written_unverified bundle establishes structure only. Final Cut or Resolve import, visible alignment, native frame IDs, musical correctness and listening acceptance are separate future evidence.

tools.name: annotation_markers
tools.title: Annotation v2 marker projection
tools.description: Project a sha256-pinned run-local review-annotations-v2.json into generic marker JSON/CSV (markers.COLUMNS + basis_label) with visible/suppressed counts and reasons; refuses stale store hashes; note/quote text omitted unless include_text.
tools.intent: Make structured user-reported and reference-review annotations shareable as source-timed markers while keeping each row's assertion basis visible and distinct from detector hypotheses.

run_dir.description: Existing local run holding regular manifest.json and review-annotations-v2.json; traversal, URL and symlink components reject. Relative paths resolve from the repository root.

store_sha256.description: Exact lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the current review-annotations-v2.json bytes; a stale or changed store refuses.

output_dir.description: Fresh directory beneath repository artifacts/ with an existing parent, outside run_dir; receives annotation-markers.json and annotation-markers.csv. An existing path rejects.

include_text.description: Copy note/operator_quote text verbatim into the marker evidence. Default false keeps the shareable interchange free of free text.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard owned-worker/process-group deadline in seconds; independent of client timeout.

limitations: Reads only run-local manifest.json and review-annotations-v2.json (store <=1MB); never opens audio, never writes the run and never edits the annotation store. Output is a fresh directory beneath repository artifacts/; nothing is overwritten.

Basis labels USER REPORTED / INTENT / REVIEW / REFERENCE REVIEW are assertion provenance, not verdicts; musical_verdict stays not_established and performance_issue_confirmed false. Points keep end == start; no duration is invented.

At most two simultaneously visible callouts by the frozen basis-priority rule; suppressed rows remain in suppressed_markers with a reason. editor_import is not_validated, picture_coverage not_evaluated and listening_acceptance not_established.
The existing marked_video renderer does not yet draw the basis badge; annotation-marker rows rendered there cannot be told apart from detector rows until that root-owned change lands.

dependencies.note: Requires an existing v2 store and its current SHA-256 (read it with annotation_v2 first); this tool does not create or change annotations.

agent_workflow.identify: Read the current v2 store with annotation_v2, note its revision and SHA-256, and decide whether free text may leave the run before choosing include_text.
agent_workflow.research: Read docs/spec/sprints/ANNOT_CORPUS_S2.md section 1 and docs/spec/ANNOTATION_V2_VOCABULARY.md; the basis label states who asserted a row, not whether it is correct.
agent_workflow.iterate: Re-project into a fresh output after a store revision changes; compare visible/suppressed counts and suppression reasons rather than editing rows to change visibility.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A projection establishes marker interchange structure only; it establishes no mistake, intended note, editor import, rendered badge or listening acceptance.

tools.name: flags_triage
tools.title: Default review ordering of run flags
tools.description: Order an existing run's flags.json into flags-triage.json: at most one shown flag per phrase span or 16-period click-grid navigation window by rule flags-triage-priority-v1; navigation proxies hidden but retained; denominators total/hidden/suppressed/shown; no new kinds, no numeric confidence use, no verdict.
tools.intent: Give a musician a compact default review order over existing hypotheses without dropping, re-scoring or reclassifying any flag.

run_dir.description: Existing local run holding a regular flags.json (plus phrases.json/dag.json or the bound click grid); traversal, URL and symlink components reject. Relative paths resolve from the repository root.

output.description: Fresh .json file beneath repository artifacts/ with an existing parent directory, outside run_dir. An existing path rejects.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard owned-worker/process-group deadline in seconds; independent of client timeout.

limitations: Frozen rule flags-triage-priority-v1 with no knobs: tier by existing kind, hash-bound evidence slot, then source time, kind and index. Numeric confidence/similarity values are uncalibrated and never used.

Windows come from hash-bound semantic phrase spans or 16 consecutive click-grid periods; grid windows are navigation aids, not bars or downbeats. Without either basis the tool refuses rather than inventing windows.
Navigation proxies are hidden but retained verbatim in hidden_navigation; suppressed flags keep their winner. shown + suppressed_lower_priority + navigation_hidden == total_flags.

Reads run metadata only and writes one fresh file beneath repository artifacts/; the run is never written. No new flag kinds, no verdict, performance_grade not_assigned and musical_verdict not_established.

dependencies.note: Requires an existing flags.json and either hash-bound semantic phrase spans or a bound click grid; prior tools are not invoked automatically.

agent_workflow.identify: Confirm the run's flags.json is current for the source and which window basis (phrase spans or click grid) is available.
agent_workflow.research: Read docs/spec/sprints/ANNOT_CORPUS_S2.md section 2; tiers reorder existing hypotheses and never establish an error type.
agent_workflow.iterate: There are no knobs. Rerun into a fresh output after upstream flags, phrases or clicks change, and compare denominators and the shown set.
agent_workflow.acceptance: A triage view is ordering only; it establishes no mistake, missed/extra note, bar line, musical correctness or listening acceptance.

tools.name: corpus_eval_s2
tools.title: Coverage-first sparse corpus evaluation
tools.description: Validate a corpus split, then evaluate sha256-pinned untouched detector proposals against selected v2 annotations: coverage first, clock alignment status, recall only above 0.5 coverage with literal accepted operator assertions, precision always null (no reviewed-absence label), separate error and articulation axes, never inferring negatives; no audio read.
tools.intent: Measure how much of a take reviewers attended and, only where coverage is sufficient, how many literal operator-asserted issues untouched detector proposals overlap, without inferring negatives.

manifest.description: Existing local corpus split manifest inside the selected root; unsafe or symlink components are rejected before normalization can hide them.

local_root.description: Optional existing local metadata boundary; defaults to this repository. Manifest and referenced metadata must remain inside it. Grants no audio or network access.

proposals.description: Existing regular local flags JSON (<=20MB) holding untouched detector proposals; traversal, URL and symlink components reject. Relative paths resolve from the repository root.

proposals_sha256.description: Exact lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the proposals bytes; a changed file refuses.

output.description: Fresh .json file beneath repository artifacts/ with an existing parent directory, not beside the proposals file. An existing path rejects.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard owned-worker/process-group deadline in seconds; independent of client timeout.

limitations: Fixed coverage_threshold 0.5 and match tolerance 0.25 s. Below threshold, or without literal accepted operator assertions, recall is null; a null result is valid.
Precision is always null: the v2 schema has no reviewed-absence label, unlabelled time is unknown_not_negative and negatives/true_negatives/false_positives are null.

Proposals are read once, hash-pinned and never filtered, re-thresholded or re-ranked beyond excluding navigation proxies. Error and articulation axes stay separate; v2 articulation has no subtype and is not spread across technique axes.

Metadata only: no audio is read, no model runs and nothing is trained. Writes one fresh file beneath repository artifacts/. Detector latency and physical sync are uncalibrated; ground_truth_established stays false and listening_acceptance not_established.

dependencies.note: Requires a valid authored split manifest, selected v2 annotation stores and an explicit proposals file with its SHA-256; prior tools are not invoked automatically.

agent_workflow.identify: Validate the split with corpus_split, pin the exact proposals file by SHA-256 and check that proposals and annotations share the source and clock axis.
agent_workflow.research: Read docs/spec/sprints/ANNOT_CORPUS_S2.md section 3 and the corpus split contract; coverage is reviewer-attended time, never reviewed absence.
agent_workflow.iterate: Compare untouched proposal sets one at a time into fresh outputs; report coverage, clock status and denominators before any recall, and keep null results.
agent_workflow.acceptance: Recall over sparse operator assertions establishes neither precision, ground truth, note correctness, missed/extra notes nor listening acceptance.

tools.name: marked_compact
tools.title: Compact marked review movie (copy only)
tools.description: Compose a fresh MOV from a verified run's delivery AAC and a verified arrangement-marker preview picture by stream copy only. Verifies exact video/AAC packet payloads, rational clocks, AAC priming/padding, decoded PCM and decoder configuration, and rechecks every parent hash. No DSP, normalization, picture encode or new analysis; listening acceptance is never inferred.
tools.intent: Share a compact arrangement-labelled review clip that carries a chosen restored audio branch without altering either parent.

run_dir.description: Verified restoration run (audio branch) beneath repository artifacts/runs; read only.

picture_preview.description: Verified arrangement-reference marked_video output beneath artifacts/runs; read only.

arrangement_markers.description: Exact preview-run-relative arrangement marker JSON selector recorded by the preview; revalidated.

output.description: Optional fresh directory beneath repository artifacts/ but not artifacts/runs and not inside either parent; existing paths reject. Default artifacts/experiments/marked-compact-<UTC>-<hex12>.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard owned-process deadline in seconds.

limitations: Both branches must share the original SHA-256, native PCM and origin 0 with no time stretch; other origins refuse in v1.
Accepted FULLER listening label only for the identical chain with byte-identical audio; otherwise not_performed. The composite has no visual or listening review.
Markers may analyze a different signal version of the same take; markers_are_analysis_of_audio_branch records this.
Physical capture A/V synchronization, native editor import and per-passage level matching remain unverified.

dependencies.note: Current verified export and arrangement preview are required; prior tools are not invoked automatically.

agent_workflow.acceptance: Exact copy identity does not establish listening, visual, musical or sync acceptance.
agent_workflow.identify: Confirm which audio branch and which verified arrangement preview the operator wants combined; read chain_identity and markers_are_analysis_of_audio_branch.
agent_workflow.iterate: Use a fresh output per attempt; rebuild stale markers or previews with their owning tools instead of editing them.
agent_workflow.research: Inspect both parent receipts and the lane contract; investigate any refusal reason before rerunning.

tools.name: phrase_timing
tools.title: Per-phrase timing against the recorded click (experimental)
tools.description: Measure, per phrase span, signed offsets of broadband attack candidates from the nearest modelled in-recording click (fitted drift model, else constant grid) from an existing rhythm analysis.json and hash-bound arrangement markers or phrases.json review spans. Writes one fresh phrase-timing.json and abstains below 4 click-proximal onsets. Click identity unverified and capture latency uncalibrated; never a performance grade or missed-note verdict.
tools.intent: Show a musician whether each phrase tends ahead of or behind the recorded click, with abstention and uncertainty, without an intended-rhythm reference.

analysis.description: Existing rhythm analysis.json (bounded regular .json, at most 64 MiB) with attack candidates, click grid or drift model and analyzed-input SHA-256; traversal, URL and symlink components reject. Read only.

phrases.description: Arrangement-marker JSON or phrases.json with proposed_review_spans, bound to the same analyzed-input SHA-256 (else the worker refuses). Bounded regular .json; read only.

output_root.description: Directory beneath repository artifacts/ (never artifacts/runs): existing, or with an existing parent. Each call writes a fresh <UTC>-<hex12>/phrase-timing.json child; nothing is overwritten.

run_kind.description: Labels the receipt; real_take stays unvalidated until an operator spot-check.

timeout_seconds.description: Hard owned-worker/process-group deadline in seconds; independent of client timeout.

limitations: Offsets use broadband attack candidates, which can include click energy, handling noise or several merged attacks; they are not note identities.

The click reference is fitted to unverified periodic high-frequency transients; a guitar attack can displace or mask a click. Physical capture latency is uncalibrated and detector-delay compensation uses synthetic-probe medians.

Phrase spans are review candidates or reference-conditioned alignments, not detected musical boundaries. Phrases with fewer than 4 click-proximal onsets, no click grid or spans outside the analysis abstain.

Ahead/behind tendency labels on real takes are descriptive and uncalibrated. No intended-rhythm reference is used: no performance grade, missed/extra note or mistake verdict. Inputs are read only; one fresh output child is written beneath artifacts/.

dependencies.note: Requires an existing rhythm analysis.json with a click grid or drift model and a phrase source bound to the same analyzed input; prior tools are not invoked automatically.

agent_workflow.identify: Confirm the analysis and phrase source describe the same current signal version and that rhythm produced a click grid or fitted drift.
agent_workflow.research: Read docs/spec/sprints/RHYTHM_S2.md; inspect click_reference basis, drift confidence and detector-delay table before interpreting offsets.
agent_workflow.iterate: There are no knobs. After the input, rhythm analysis or phrase spans change, rerun into a fresh output and compare per-phrase medians, spreads and abstentions.
agent_workflow.acceptance: Offsets are descriptive measurements; they establish no rush/drag verdict, performance grade, missed or extra note, or listening acceptance without an operator spot-check.
